subject: MAP & evaluation sprint — private-offer procurement runway and acceptance handoff
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private-offer MAP & evaluation window request

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the demo last week. Purchasing wants a clear path: a 3-week evaluation (technical + security), a mutually agreed MAP that lists milestones for acceptance, and a billing handoff that keeps our finance team happy (private offer preferred).

Can Redwood send a short MAP (milestones, owners, timelines) and confirm what evidence you can provide for SOC2 / data retention during the eval? Also share the SOW template and how you handle invoicing for a marketplace private offer (AWS or GCP).

We'd like to kick evaluation the week of Aug 17 and aim to have a PO by Sept 7 if all checks pass.

—Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Cloud Platform, AcmeCloud
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-offer MAP & evaluation window request

Hi Elaine —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Redwood-MAP-AcmeCloud-v1.2.pdf) and a draft SOW. High level:
- Week 0 (Aug 17): Kickoff + account provisioning (private offer link + billing contact) — owner: Ava
- Week 1 (Aug 24): Technical eval (perf, latency, integration) — owner: Karthik
- Week 2 (Aug 31): Security review & evidence handoff — owner: Priyom
- Week 3 (Sept 7): Acceptance gates + PO submission/billing route confirmation — owner: Jordan

We can support either AWS Private Offer or GCP Private Catalog; for marketplace billing we typically provide an invoice path that mirrors the private offer's settlement. I linked the DocuSign-ready SOW and included a short SOC2 evidence bundle (summary; full package available under NDA).

If that schedule looks good I’ll coordinate the internal kickoff invite and loop in engineering for a focused perf test plan.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private-offer MAP & evaluation window request

Team — forwarding Acme's ask plus the MAP draft I attached to Elaine. Quick notes / who owns what: 
- Karthik: lead the 1-week technical eval; prepare a lightweight perf script (1M tokens/day sim) and a latency sweep. Provide a short compatibility matrix for both AWS and GCP private-offer variants. Attach SOW and perf plan to the kickoff.
- Priyom: security evidence handoff; confirm what we can publish (SOC2 summary, audit logs, retention defaults) without an NDA, and what needs an NDA (full SOC package).
- Jordan: procurement and billing play — outline two billing paths: (1) AWS private offer settlement (marketplace invoice flow) and (2) GCP private catalog (partner invoice). Draft the Finance acceptance checklist.

I pushed the kickoff for Aug 18 (preferred) in Acme's note since Aug 17 is a bit tight for internal prep. If everyone agrees, I'll send invites.

Ava
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-offer MAP & evaluation window request

Elaine / Ava —

I’ll own the technical eval. High-level test plan attached (perf-plan-acme.md). Quick clarifications for Acme:
- Do you expect production-scale keys or will sandbox keys suffice for the validation? Sandbox is fine for latency/correctness but we’ll need production-like samples for throughput/edge-case cache behavior.
- Preferred sequence length and common prompt patterns? If you can drop 5 representative prompts and a 1k-line sample log of average lengths that helps.

I'll prepare two model configs (quantized small variant for cost checks; standard L2 for latency) so you can see trade-offs during week 1.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Acme Cloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-offer MAP & evaluation window request

Hi Ava / Jordan —

Thanks for the MAP. Two procurement asks: (1) please confirm whether Redwood will accept the Acme PO template (attached), and (2) we need an invoice routing decision — will Acme be billed via the AWS private-offer invoice settlement or will Redwood invoice Acme directly under a partner agreement? For a private-offer path we need the offer ID and expected invoice cadence to line up with our AP schedule.

Attached: Acme-PO-template.pdf. Target PO submission: 2026-09-07.

—Procurement Team
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Cloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-offer MAP & evaluation window request

Hi Procurement —

Short answer: we can support both paths, but here's recommended default and the runbook: 
- Preferred: AWS Private Offer (fastest finance reconciliation). After acceptance we'll provide the Private Offer ID and the Marketplace billing schedule; AWS will settle to Redwood and Acme receives one AWS invoice. This is easiest for your AP.
- Alternate: Redwood issues partner invoice (Net30) tied to our SOW — useful if you need direct Redwood invoicing for accounting reasons.

Next steps: Ava will confirm which option Acme prefers after acceptance gates. Jordan will produce a 1-page finance acceptance checklist and include expected offer ID format and invoice cadence by Monday Aug 17.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-AcmeCloud-v1.2.pdf, SOW-draft-AcmeCloud.docx, SOC2-evidence-summary.zip

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff next week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
